description: Path traversal is its own judgement rather than a spelling of injection: nothing is executed, the caller simply chooses a different file than the application meant to open. Its own policy and its own context. The second route passes the same value through path.basename, which reduces a path to its final segment so no traversal survives it, and is not a finding. The third uses a fixed path. The contents are deliberately not echoed back, so this corpus tests one judgement rather than two.

expected.note: the caller names the file that is read
the caller names the file that is deleted
